title: Daily Dose #392: The Father Who Sees
body:
**“Your Father who sees in secret will reward you.”**

Jesus warned against turning generosity into a performance. A good action can be emptied of love when it is mainly done to build our image.

God sees what receives no public response: the quiet gift, the private prayer, the temptation resisted and the care offered when no one is watching. His attention is enough.

This does not mean every good work must be hidden. Jesus also said to let good works point people toward the Father. The question is motive: are we helping someone, or using their need to advertise ourselves?

Do one good thing today that does not need to become a story. Let the Father’s approval free you from chasing everyone else’s.

Hidden faithfulness is fully visible to God.
